title: WritingSystem
description: Reference schema for docs/timeline/SPEC.md §7.1's WritingSystem node type. Entities aggregate claims; they assert nothing on their own — every substantive statement about a WritingSystem lives in a linked Claim (subject_type: WritingSystem, subject_id: this entity's id), not inline here. origin_type is the field SPEC.md explicitly names and Phase 3's exit criterion (SPEC.md §10) is graded on: 'Origin-type honestly classified... no independent-invention overclaims.' The hand-rolled validator (docs/timeline/scripts/validate-timeline.mjs) is authoritative if this file and the validator diverge.

name.description: Common name used across the app, e.g. 'Cuneiform', 'Maya script', 'Cherokee syllabary'.

origin_type.description: SPEC.md §7.1. INDEPENDENT = invented with no evidence of prior contact with any existing script. STIMULUS_DIFFUSION = the knowledge that writing was possible reached the inventor(s) via contact with an existing script, but the actual sign system was built from scratch (e.g. Cherokee syllabary, Vai script). ADAPTATION = an existing script's signs/principles were directly borrowed and modified for a new language. UNCERTAIN = the evidence does not currently settle which of the above applies. This field is deliberately never 'derived silently' — the classification and its basis belong on a backing Claim, not asserted here without one.

script_type.description: Structural classification, where established. UNKNOWN is valid for undeciphered/disputed scripts where even this is not settled (e.g. the Indus script's status as writing at all is itself contested).

date_range.description: The script's attested-use window, not a claimed invention date independent of evidence — mirrors Population.date_range's rationale (SPEC.md P1: earliest-surviving is not first-ever).

latest.description: null for scripts still in active use.

descends_from.description: Ids of WritingSystem entities this one derives from, where ADAPTATION or STIMULUS_DIFFUSION applies (e.g. Greek descends_from Phoenician). Each edge needs a backing Claim, same pattern as Population.gene_flow_edges.

claim_id.description: The Claim that sources this derivation.
